title: CALIPER: Comparative Analysis of LLM Inference Perturbation, Evaluation, and Ranking
description: CALIPER v1.0.0 is a reproducible factorial LLM evaluation framework for variance-aware analysis and ranking stability, accompanying Paper 1 (EMSE manuscript). Authors: César Andrés (corresponding; ORCID 0009-0001-8968-3404); David Martín-Moncunill (ORCID 0000-0003-2422-9005); José Manuel Baños (ORCID 0009-0004-9971-7390); CRIA-BDHS, Universidad Camilo José Cela. This archive includes the Paper 1 frozen statistical dataset under artifacts/paper1/ (N=39,360 HumanEval+ cells; SHA-256 95209fff2f742d59b52aa5cf5616f1395ef7fc01fd87fe025c485577bca0d1c9), freeze/integrity/recovery documentation, protocol amendment comparison (40→164 tasks), GLMM/variance exports, and analysis-reproduction scripts. Entry points: README.md, artifacts/paper1/README.md, docs/getting-started.md, docs/author_identity.md. DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21780089. Development: https://github.com/cesar-andress/caliper.
